design.admission: First qualifying independently generated rewrite per work per generator. Exactly one changed native source sentence, all others retained; require at least 8 distinct held works and 6 per generator before held scoring.

params.prompt:
Paraphrase this English sentence once. Preserve its meaning, names and technical terms. Return exactly one complete sentence, with no headings or explanation.

{sentence}

overflow_repair.method: Incumbent baseline-only native windows over 512 tokens use the existing non-overlapping production tokenizer pooling. Candidate still requires its complete <=512-token input. No locations or points changed.

source.source_method: Latest eligible version of record among archival v2/v3 sources, one native unchanged excerpt and one constructed substitution using an exact donor from a different prose block of the same source. Order fixed before scoring.
